q: Energy sources can be classified as two major sources: conventional sources and _____ sources.
e: Energy sources can be classified as two major sources: conventional sources and non-conventional sources. Alternative or secondary is not this quantity.

q: Conventional energy sources are _____ energy sources.
e: Conventional energy sources are non-renewable energy sources. Renewable or sustainable is not this quantity.

q: Non-conventional energy sources are _____ energy sources.
e: Non-conventional energy sources are renewable energy sources. Do not trade renewable for non-renewable or fossil.

q: A renewable energy source is generated from unlimited natural sources and is always _____.
e: A renewable energy source is generated from unlimited natural sources and is always replenished. Consumed or depleted is not this quantity.

q: Solar energy, wind energy, hydro energy, tidal energy, geothermal energy and biomass energy are examples of _____ energy sources.
e: Solar energy, wind energy, hydro energy, tidal energy, geothermal energy and biomass energy are examples of renewable energy sources. Do not trade renewable for non-renewable or fossil.

q: The four major roles of a renewable energy are electricity generation, air and water heating/cooling, the replacement of fossil fuels, and zero or minimal amounts of _____.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. The four major roles of a renewable energy are electricity generation, air and water heating/cooling, the replacement of fossil fuels, and zero or minimal amounts of greenhouse gases. Do not trade greenhouse gases for oxygen or water vapor.

q: Non-renewable energy comes from sources that will run out or will not be replenished for thousands or even _____ of years.
e: Non-renewable energy comes from sources that will run out or will not be replenished for thousands or even millions of years. Do not trade millions for hundreds or billions.

q: Four main types of non-renewable energy sources are oil, natural gas, coal and _____ energy.
e: Four main types of non-renewable energy sources are oil, natural gas, coal and nuclear energy. Solar or wind is not this quantity.

q: Oil, natural gas and coal are collectively called _____ fuels.
e: Oil, natural gas and coal are collectively called fossil fuels. Do not trade fossil for bio or synthetic.

q: Fossil fuels were formed within the earth from dead plants and animals over _____ of years.
e: Fossil fuels were formed within the earth from dead plants and animals over millions of years. Thousands or decades is not this quantity.

q: Nuclear energy is produced by using elements like uranium and _____.
e: Nuclear energy is produced by using elements like uranium and thorium. Plutonium or radium is not this quantity.

q: Nuclear energy can be used to generate electricity by means of nuclear _____.
e: Nuclear energy can be used to generate electricity by means of nuclear fission. Do not trade fission for fusion or decay.

q: In a nuclear reactor, the nuclear fuel is used to carry out sustained _____ chain reaction to produce electricity.
e: In a nuclear reactor, the nuclear fuel is used to carry out sustained fission chain reaction to produce electricity. Fusion or chemical is not this quantity.

q: Biomass is plant or animal material used as fuel to produce _____ or heat.
e: Cathode rays go in straight lines, bend in electric or magnetic fields, ionize gas, and make fluorescence. Biomass is plant or animal material used as fuel to produce electricity or heat. Do not trade electricity for light or motion.

q: Agricultural waste, wood, charcoal or dried dung are used as _____.
e: Agricultural waste, wood, charcoal or dried dung are used as biomass. Do not trade biomass for fossil fuels or nuclear fuel.

q: Tidal energy is another form of hydro energy that uses tidal currents _____ to drive turbine generator.
e: Tidal energy is another form of hydro energy that uses tidal currents twice-daily to drive turbine generator. Do not trade twice-daily for continuously or monthly.

q: Sun is the _____ source of energy.
e: Sun is the primary source of energy. Do not trade primary for secondary or artificial.

q: With the help of photovoltaic technology, solar energy can be used to generate _____.
e: With the help of photovoltaic technology, solar energy can be used to generate electricity. Biomass or tidal power is not this quantity.
